content: No evidence Zendesk agent view rows carry a priority class or data attribute. The maintained liferay-zendesk-userscript reads priority from the Zendesk REST API, not the DOM; the pioug gist reads it by regex over tr.textContent. Verified Zendesk-specific attributes present in agent views: div[data-test-id=table_container], table[data-test-id=table_header] (sticky duplicate header table), table[data-test-id=table_main] / table[data-onboarding-id=table_main], tr[data-test-id=generic-table-row], td[data-test-id=generic-table-cells-id], td[data-test-id=ticket-table-cells-subject], div[data-cy-test-id=status-badge-state], div#views_views-ticket-table, span[data-test-id=views_views-header-page-amount], button[data-test-id=generic-table-pagination-first|next]. Conclusion: a CSS-only extension is impossible; priority must be read from cell text and stamped as a data attribute.
